about: The one list of GitHub labels of the 4 repositories (standards/github.md, section Labels; system#508, system#515). bin/labels_sync.py makes each repository hold `canonical`; bin/github_check.py renames a label outside `canonical`, `families` or `defaults` and every `old` name on open issues; the hook claim-guard refuses an agent write of an off-list or old label (system#739); Boss is never blocked, the hook runs for agents only.

canonical.name: in-progress
canonical.description: An agent works this issue now; the queue skips it

canonical.name: status:review
canonical.description: Merged; an agent re-checks the proof on its Proof date

canonical.name: blocked:access
canonical.description: Waits for an access; the line is in Accesses agents need

canonical.name: boss:question
canonical.description: Boss was asked one question; his next answer removes it

canonical.name: auto-fixed
canonical.description: Fixed and proved in the run that found it; the issue is the log

canonical.name: auditor
canonical.description: Opened by an auditor; closes when its check is green

canonical.name: repeat
canonical.description: A closed cause came back: the first fix missed the root cause

canonical.name: memory
canonical.description: A record, not work: the engineer queue skips it

canonical.name: engineer:mac
canonical.description: Claimed by the Mac per-issue engineer

canonical.name: engineer:cloud
canonical.description: Claimed by the cloud per-issue engineer

canonical.name: engineer:mac-needed
canonical.description: The cloud engineer hands the issue to the Mac

canonical.name: engineer:skip
canonical.description: Sorter: not work for an engineer

canonical.name: priority:1
canonical.description: First in the engineer queue of its repository

canonical.name: priority:2
canonical.description: Second in the engineer queue of its repository

canonical.name: priority:3
canonical.description: Third in the engineer queue of its repository

canonical.name: duplicate
canonical.description: This issue already exists; closed with the link

canonical.name: cco
canonical.description: One run of the CCO (weekly audit): numbers, big-task analysis, fixes

canonical.name: cco:article
canonical.description: A new Claude article for the CCO: what it means for us, one change or close

canonical.name: needs:artifact
canonical.description: Proof is a published Boss page: needs the Artifact tool; the Mac headless run never starts it

canonical.name: class:access
canonical.description: A key, login or right that a job needs is missing, dead or refused (token, secret, API key, account)

canonical.name: class:job-down
canonical.description: A job did not run or failed: routine, worker, auditor, cron, watcher, service

canonical.name: class:wrong-number
canonical.description: A check, report or tile shows a wrong, stale or missing number

canonical.name: class:cost
canonical.description: Spend on models or services: a swing, a wrong model, a credit or a plan limit

canonical.name: class:guard
canonical.description: A hook, gate or rule blocks good work or lets bad work pass

canonical.name: class:queue
canonical.description: Work waits: an issue not taken, no owner, a stuck claim, a session that waits

canonical.name: class:content
canonical.description: Reader copy: quality, Czech, approval or publication of a text

canonical.name: class:data
canonical.description: Wrong or missing data in a store: adverts, records, CRM, a sync

canonical.name: class:page
canonical.description: A page of a site: broken UI, wrong text, SEO or speed

canonical.name: class:deploy
canonical.description: A merged change is not live, or a deploy or build failed

canonical.name: needs:browser
canonical.description: Next step needs a signed-in browser (Chrome tool); the Mac watcher never starts it
